description: Limits that keep a TextDiff comparison bounded. The defaults suit interactive review of prose and terminal-sized source files; a host that diffs very large documents on purpose can raise them, and a host that wants an early degradation can lower them.

members.name: DefaultMaxCells
members.description: Default value of MaxCells (4 000 000 cells ≈ 16 MB of table).

members.name: Default
members.description: Shared immutable instance used when a caller passes no options.

members.name: MaxCells
members.description: Maximum number of cells in the longest-common-subsequence table built after stripping the common prefix and suffix — the real memory guard, because two very different inputs inside MaxTokens can still require a quadratic table. Exceeding it degrades exactly like MaxTokens does. Values below 1 are treated as 1. Defaults to DefaultMaxCells.

members.name: MaxTokens
members.description: Maximum number of tokens (words or lines) per input before the comparison degrades: a word diff falls back to line level, a line diff to a single whole-text change. Values below 1 are treated as 1. Defaults to DefaultMaxTokens.
